top_signals.title: Global Bonds Recover as Warsh’s Inflation Fight Calms Market
top_signals.summary: Global bond yields retreated Thursday, calming a pressured market after the Federal Reserve’s rate hike and Chairman Kevin Warsh’s vow to tame inflation, while traders awaited Friday’s Bank of Japan decision.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Myanmar Deports Detained Ex-AmCham Chief to ‘Preserve’ US Ties
top_signals.summary: Myanmar deported American businessman Adam Castillo on Wednesday evening, ending a three-month detention for breach of trust in a move the authorities said was aimed at preserving diplomatic relations with the US.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Thai protest leader who seized Bangkok airport is back in action
top_signals.summary: Sondhi Limthongkul's efforts mark the reemergence of street politics after relative calm and point to discontent building beneath the surface.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Australia to bar foreign students from bringing their partners and children
top_signals.summary: At present, international students can bring their spouses and partners and dependent children under the age of 18 into Australia to accompany them.
